transcript.text: I need to flag a significant finding from my collateral file review this week. While the borrowing-base report submitted with the renewal request lists $10,000,000 of eligible receivables, I found that $1,500,000 of those are invoices owed by entities under the borrower's common ownership. Our policy excludes related-party receivables, which leaves exactly $8,500,000 truly eligible. Applying the 80% advance rate, the maximum commitment we can support is $6,800,000 — not the $8,000,000 being requested. I also want to note that an approved renewal at this risk level requires a monthly borrowing-base certificate. I have not yet entered this finding into the credit system.
